writing.s:
Jack the Ripper has vanished from London. His disappearance leaves behind one of history's most notorious unsolved mysteries.
But Jack hasn't stopped.
He has traveled to America.
Assuming the identity of a doctor, the killer joins a westward journey through the American frontier, surrounded by travelers unaware of the monster accompanying them.
The expedition encounters dangers both human and supernatural. Bounty hunters, corrupt soldiers, and mysterious forces connected to the land complicate an already perilous journey.
As the travelers venture deeper into unfamiliar territory, the threat concealed within their own company becomes increasingly dangerous.
The story combines the historical mystery of Jack the Ripper with the isolation, violence, and mythology of the American West.

An extraordinary mechanical invention promises to change the nature of armed conflict.
The machine gun represents a technological breakthrough unlike anything the world has previously experienced.
But the invention attracts dangerous attention.
As the weapon progresses from prototype through failure and refinement, competing interests recognize its extraordinary military and commercial value.
The resulting struggle involves theft, industrial espionage, kidnapping, imprisonment, and a pursuit across the American West.
Among those drawn into the conflict is Westbrook, a particularly dangerous and unpredictable individual whose capacity for violence threatens everyone around him.
Stokes emerges as an important opposing force, while Susan becomes directly exposed to the human consequences of the struggle.
At the center of the story is the machine itself.
The invention is more than an object being pursued. It represents a permanent transformation in humanity's capacity for destruction.
Once the technology exists, the world cannot simply return to what it was.

Convicted murders Bozz and SammyBoy have just 
busted out of prison and are on the run in the California desert. Without money or drugs, 
they find out where the local drug dealer resides and attempt to rob him. The escaped 
cons may bite off more than they can chew when attempting to rob this particular 
dealer, who breeds and fights mutated dogs. What could go wrong when the pack of 
juiced-up hybrid hounds escape? Tremors meets Pulp Fiction.

1890s. San Diego, California. The recent addition 
of the railroad has caused a real estate boom and the people are flocking south. Where there is a 
concentration of boomers, there is vice. Where there is vice, there is crime. Former lawman and 
current businessman Wyatt Earp and his brother Virgil are new in town. His days in Tombstone, 
over. His days of being in the middle of opportunity and the trouble it brings, perhaps just getting 
started. Before Wyatt can secure legitimate business, he must confer with the power players- The 
wealthy madame who runs the town’s lucrative brothels, a powerful Chinese baron who controls 
the cheap labor, Mexican Dons, the US military, and the local police department. Do Wyatt and 
Virgil, former lawmen, have what it take to survive and succeed on both sides of the law? 
Deadwood meets Boardwalk Empire.

1978. Camp Pendleton, California. Home to over 70,000 
marines. Navy surgeon and Urologist Dr. MacMullen is due to report for new orders. 
Before he gets a chance, he is persuaded to coach the Navy football team, which has 
been winless the last 3 seasons. The new coach is forced to recruit, coach, and 
ultimately make hard-nosed football players out of a bunch of navy swabbies. Bad News 
bears meets M.A.S.H.

After getting dumped by his super fit 
yoga instructor girlfriend, Larry starts drinking. Heavily. Larry drinks enough beer to turn his once 
semi flabby stomach into a full fledge beer gut. Larry hates working out. Larry likes smoking pot, 
drinking beer, and watching wrestling. Then Larry gets a life changing idea. What does Larry love? 
Beer and professional wrestling. What does he need to do? Workout. Why not come up with an epic 
combination of his loves and win back his girlfriend. Bitchin. He needs the help of his two closest 
friends to pull it off. And a camouflage leotard. It’s time for Larry and friends to shape up. Silicon 
Valley meets Pineapple Express.

Do you even lift, bro? Erik, in fact, does not lift. He has never picked up 
a weight in his life. The die-hard muscleheads at 24 hr UGLY (Universal Gym and Living Yoga) studio 
sure as hell do. When overweight Erik finally stops in late night for a membership, little did he know 
the world as he knows it was about to change. A group of powerlifters, AKA ‘The Rage’, experiment 
with a new batch of steroids that at first produce amazing results. But then, side effects. Terrible side 
effects. Mutating side effects. Side effects that turn them into raging killers who barricade the exits 
and systematically kill gym members. The terrified yoga staff, along with their new leader Erik, have 
to dig deep and really make it burn to survive Erik’s hellish first and possible last day in the gym. 
Shawn of the Dead meets Supertroopers.
